text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"Come to this place wearing your Racewear", was it?
If it weren't in your handwriting, I might not have come, you know?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: —Fuji.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (BANG!!!)

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: —In other words, you came precisely because it was me.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: "All the more reason, then, that I must make sure you enjoy tonight."

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, amazing!
It's even flashier than usual...!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
—Bubble.
Tonight, I shall answer
the declaration you gave me.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: “――――I declare this.”

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"I will definitely repay this debt with my running from here on out.
I'll deliver results in the Classic races for Fuji's sake too.
That's why—"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: "Fuji, you come back soon too—"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Though it was late—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Slipping into these racing silks once again, and the resolve to run upon the turf. A body built for that very purpose.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...At long last, everything's in order.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"With my deepest gratitude to you,
I'll deliver it 'faster' than anyone else tonight."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Will you take this?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Of course, Fuji!
I've been waiting for a day like this...!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Let's clash your new running style
against mine as it is now!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Fufu—
Well then, for tonight's race,
shall we go with 2000m, clockwise?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: ...Could it be the Satsuki Sho?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Indeed.
The turning point of destiny... for you and me.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: And yet, you see, that's not the only reason.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Watching your hoofprints up until now...
Your strength at medium distance has made me dream."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: "This strength is what I must surpass when I return," that is.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: —Now, let the showdown begin. To those who harbor swelling dreams!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"With the greatest 'miracle'—
I'll make your heart dance!"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
I'm bursting with energy...!!
Let's settle this, Fuji Kiseki!!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: —HAAAH!!!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
(Incredible...!
Just how much effort did it take to get here...!)

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
I'll answer your call, Fuji...!!
With my—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
With the greatest run of allllll!!!!
HAAAAAAAHHHH!!!!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: —I've always thought to myself...

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
If you weren't the kindest Umamusume of all...
who cares about everyone more than anyone else—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
If she wasn't running across the turf
faster than any of us—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"I definitely wouldn't be here.
...I wouldn't have made it this far. That's why—"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Thank you for giving me a miracle, Fuji.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ――……You're always so straightforward, Bubble.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: That is why everyone dreams of you—

text_block_list.name: Academy Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
“—Did you see this?! Fuji-senpai's press conference...!
She's really making a comeback...!!”

text_block_list.name: Academy Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
I saw it, I saw it, it was amazing...! 
Social media is talking about nothing else...! 
People are saying, 'It's a true miracle, don't wake me up if this is a dream'...!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: I mean, Fuji—
